{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm the question only involves `converted` and `customer_segment`
print("Unique values in customer_segment:")
print(data['customer_segment'].unique())

print("\nSample of converted values:")
print(data['converted'].sample(5))

# Check for the presence of refunded orders
print("\nStatus distribution:")
print(data['status'].value_counts())

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue 999999.99
print("\nNumber of rows with revenue == '999999.99':")
print(data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0])

# Check if any order has status 'refunded' and converted = 1
print("\nNumber of refunded orders with converted = 1:")
print(data[(data['status'] == 'refunded') & (data['converted'] == 1)].shape[0])"}
